comparison.objective: Prove a voltage detector before and after testing a bar, or stop safely when proving fails.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate buttons and maneuver a long detector stick through a safety-critical prove-test-prove procedure.
comparison.success_condition: Working and failed-tester seeds require the correct timed indications, touches, or safe withdrawal sequence.
comparison.reason: This primarily tests procedural electrical verification and long-tool positioning, not mechanical adjustment or countertorque locking.
